{{Quote|Lay claws on one of my boys, will ya? I'm gonna rearrange you brain, hairball.|Lightning Battalion soldier|<ref name="EOTE1">[[Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire 1|''Boba Fett: Enemy of the Empire'' 1]]</ref>}}
A [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''individual''' was in [[Port-Esta]], the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Vestar/Legends|Vestar]], brawling with members of [[Lightning Battalion]], an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] unit. The [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] intervened and knocked the Wookiee out by throwing an object on his head. He then interrogated the battalion members about their former [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Abal Karda]]. When the Wookiee regained consciousness, he tried to attack Fett again, who promptly shot and [[Death|killed]] him.<ref name="EOTE1" />
